items.title: Ed Allen Interview, 1961-01-14
items.q: And I understand that he gets a royalty from Decker and gets so much money from him.

ctx.x: I know a whole lot of New Orleans fellas had numbers published by Clarence Williams that now belong to Decker. Yeah, that's right. Decker brought the whole catalog out.
And I understand that he gets a royalty from Decker and gets so much money from him. Yeah, he should. He should.
He probably does. Sure, any time one of his numbers comes out on the record, he's supposed to be paid royalty.
